fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition published a tender notice on 13 April 2026 (IAS n°01/2026/PARAE, African Development Bank loan) for equipment for an artificial intelligence and big data laboratory to process public data.
title: Côte d'Ivoire: la BAD finance un laboratoire d'IA et de big data. Pourquoi Abidjan ne veut plus sous-traiter l'intelligence de son administration
